summary: The ne test is a Jinja builtin comparison test; the chunk's description text is truncated, but by name it is the not-equal comparison.
questions: Is there a not-equal test in Jinja?
How do I filter items not equal to a value with a test?

answer_card.title: ne test
answer_card.answer_md: `ne` is a Jinja builtin comparison test (not equal, i.e. `a != b`). The source description here is truncated, so see the Jinja tests documentation for details. Example: `items | select('ne', 'skip')`.
